rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a summary of the main news items.

example.english: This morning's roundup covered several of the most important news stories.
example.traditional: 今朝份新聞摘要講咗幾單最重要嘅新聞。
example.jyutping: gam1 ziu1 fan6 san1 man4 zaak6 jiu3 gong2 zo2 gei2 daan1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 san1 man4

rows.note: Use this for a police operation to find and arrest a group of suspects.

example.english: The police carried out a roundup last night and arrested several suspects.
example.traditional: 警方噚晚展開大搜捕，拘捕咗幾個疑犯。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 cam4 maan5 zin2 hoi1 daai6 sau2 bou6 keoi1 bou6 zo2 gei2 go3 ji4 faan2

rows.jyutping: daai6 kwai1 mou4 laai1 jan4 hang4 dung6
rows.note: Use this colloquial event phrase when people are forcibly rounded up in large numbers rather than when cattle or suspects are specifically being searched for.

example.english: The authorities suddenly launched a roundup, and many workers in the streets were taken away.
example.traditional: 當局突然發起大規模拉人行動，街上好多工人都畀人帶走。
